reference: Approved This Week in AI raster logo used as a style reference for H1 only; existing assets were not modified.

proposals.name: Folded H
proposals.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: square avatar logo proposal for an independent weekly newsletter named This Week in HN, covering Hacker News.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only: the established sibling newsletter's blue folded A. Create a NEW logo, not an edit or recoloring of the A.
Primary request: one distinctive capital H formed from a bold folded ribbon, with two sturdy vertical stems joined by a visible horizontal crossbar. It must read instantly as H, not A, N, M, or a generic zigzag. Rounded outer ends, confident simple silhouette, carefully balanced negative space, subtle folded-over intersection.
Palette: warm saturated orange front faces (#F26A21) and deep burnt orange folded reverse (#9B3714), on a uniform pale warm ivory (#FAF8F3) background. This color choice connects the subject to Hacker News while giving this publication its own mark.
Style: polished minimal graphic logo, smooth vector-like contours, restrained two-tone fold depth like the reference, not a photoreal 3D object.
Composition: exactly one large centered mark occupying roughly 68% of the square, generous crop-safe margins suitable for a circular avatar. No detached square, no border, no text except the stylized H itself, no title, no tiny text, no mockup, no watermark. Render one clean square asset.

proposals.name: HN monogram
proposals.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: square newsletter avatar logo concept for This Week in HN.
Primary request: an original, very legible uppercase HN ligature. H on the left and N on the right share a central upright, creating a compact single typographic symbol. Bold geometric editorial lettering, subtly softened outer corners, exact optical spacing, with a diagonal negative-space cut making the N clear. The monogram must read HN, not NN or HM.
Palette: rich orange (#F26A21) symbol on pale warm ivory (#FAF8F3), with a small deep burnt-orange face only if helpful to define the shared upright.
Style: flat, confident, minimal logo design appropriate to a curated technology newsletter, elegant custom lettering rather than a stock font.
Composition: one compact centered symbol occupying about 72% of the square width with generous circular-crop-safe margins. No Y, no official Hacker News or Y Combinator mark. No other letters, no title, no frame, no decoration, no texture, no perspective, no mockup, no watermark. Deliver one clean square logo.

proposals.name: Weekly pages
proposals.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: square avatar logo concept for This Week in HN, an independent Hacker News weekly digest.
Primary request: a distinctive folded-newsletter symbol that also reads as a clear capital N. Form the N from two broad pale paper strips and a diagonal folded bridge; a single short offset paper edge behind the top left gives the sense of gathered weekly pages. Keep the shape bold and simple, with gently rounded ends and one purposeful fold.
Palette: warm ivory (#FAF8F3) main symbol with a lighter peach folded reverse, set on a solid rich orange background (#E96025) filling the entire square.
Style: minimal modern editorial mark, vector-like precision, slight two-tone paper-fold depth, sophisticated and crisp. It should harmonize with a blue folded A sibling newsletter and a rounded W umbrella brand without copying them.
Composition: one large optically centered N/page mark about 66% of the square, comfortable crop-safe margins. No tiny lines or article text, no Y, no official Hacker News or Y Combinator mark, no slogan, no title, no icon grid, no 3D mockup, no watermark. Render one clean square asset.
